items.summary: Microsoft Entra ID updates MFA flows to prioritize more secure non-telephony methods over SMS and voice, which remain available under "Show more verification methods." items.summary: Starting early December, the minimum iOS/iPadOS Company Portal version will be v5.2608.0 to support new Apple OS releases. Most users update automatically; others will be prompted. If app installation is blocked via device restrictions, manual updates may be needed. Prepare helpdesk for update prompts.

items.summary: Microsoft is updating Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows to block.msix and.msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting December 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should allow them in policies before rollout; no action needed otherwise.

items.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to temporarily pause notifications for a chosen duration to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out globally from mid-September to November 2026. No admin action is needed; users can enable it via their profile menu.

items.title: MC1526651: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages starting mid-November 2026, warning users of harmful links. Detection applies to chats and channels, with external QR codes blurred by default. The feature is enabled via existing Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

items.title: MC1537353: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is expanding the "Invite to register" feature for events, allowing organizers to email registration links. Rolling out worldwide by late November 2026. items.title: MC1508234: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show automatic recording and transcription settings based on assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. Rollout starts mid-November 2026, completing by mid-December. No admin action is needed; organizers see only options allowed by their policies.

items.title: MC1506734: Microsoft Teams: Video sharing from OneDrive in Teams events
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow event organizers and producers to share videos directly from OneDrive during Teams events using "Manage what attendees see," enabling smoother, higher-quality playback without screen sharing or embedding in PowerPoint. Rollout begins mid-November 2026, with no action required.

items.title: MC1546438: Action may be required: Claude models in Copilot are coming into the EU Data Boundary and will be enabled by default
items.summary: Starting December 9, 2026, Claude models in Microsoft Copilot will be enabled by default for eligible EU and EFTA tenants, with data processing moved into the EU Data Boundary. Admins can opt out or limit access before that date via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

items.title: MC1546447: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Updated recipient inclusion logic for threat protection policies
items.summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will change recipient inclusion logic in threat protection policies from Match all (AND) to Match any (OR) when multiple recipient types are specified. This update, rolling out in December 2026, expands policy scope upon modification but does not auto-convert existing policies.

items.title: MC1546430: 'Add explainer video' Skill in PPT Copilot
items.summary: The "Add explainer video" skill in PowerPoint Copilot, available on desktop, Mac, and web, will roll out to Frontier users worldwide from early to mid-November 2026. It converts static slides into animated explainer videos. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.

items.title: MC1546429: Power BI retiring standalone Copilot experiences (preview)
items.summary: Power BI will retire the standalone Copilot preview in January 2027, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot enabled by default from December 8, 2026. Standalone Copilot access and settings will be removed; organizations should prepare for this transition and notify users accordingly.

items.title: MC1489971: Microsoft Purview DLP: Improved setup and Intune multi-admin approval support for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will improve setup and activation for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business starting late November 2026, adding support for Intune multi-admin approval. Enhancements include clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune admins, with no policy migration needed.

items.title: MC1546411: Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
items.summary: Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Viva Learning analytics remain accessible within the Viva Learning app. Admins should update documentation and inform reporting administrators of this change.

items.title: MC1546409: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. items.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
items.summary: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates—icons, spacing, and alignment—for improved clarity and consistency starting mid-November 2026. A nonintrusive "What’s New" dialog will inform users monthly. No admin action is needed; these changes do not alter workflows or replace the classic experience.

items.summary: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the included quota. This opt-in feature, rolling out globally in January 2027, integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive and requires Azure billing permissions.

Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

items.summary: The Outlook for Windows Usage Report in the Exchange admin center will retire in early April 2027. Admins must use the Microsoft 365 admin center for Outlook usage data. No user impact or admin action is needed, but update any documentation referencing the retired report.

items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone) for users with Copilot (Premium) licenses, enabling AI-generated summaries and note interaction. items.title: MC1309746: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android)
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) for users with Premium licenses, enabling AI-generated summaries and Q&A on notes. Rollout begins end of November 2026, with existing Copilot policies applying and no admin action required before deployment.

items.title: MC1540351: Microsoft Teams: Automatically add tag members to channels with Workflows
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Workflows app template to automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. This optional feature, rolling out worldwide in mid-December 2026, helps streamline access for location- or project-based groups without default changes.

items.summary: Microsoft is updating Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 permissions, replacing Exchange.ManageV2 and Exchange.ManageAsAppV2 with new permissions by November 2026.
